title: AlphaLISA Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Pause and wait for user to resume.

steps.title: Transfer sample dilution
steps.instruction: Use the p20 multi‑channel pipette to transfer 8 µL of the sample serial dilution from slot 3 well A1‑A12 into the specified wells of plate 1.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 8 µL to slot 1 wells A1‑A12.
Transfer 8 µL to slot 1 wells B1‑B12.
Transfer 8 µL to slot 1 wells A13‑A24.
Transfer 8 µL to slot 1 wells B13‑B24.

steps.title: Transfer ligand 1
steps.instruction: Use the p20 multi‑channel pipette to transfer 4 µL of ligand 1 from slot 5 well A1 into plate 1.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 4 µL to slot 1 wells A1‑A24.
Transfer 4 µL to slot 1 wells B1‑B24.

steps.title: Transfer ligand 2
steps.instruction: Use the p20 multi‑channel pipette to transfer 4 µL of ligand 2 to the plate located in slot 2 (source well not specified).

steps.title: Pause for user
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and wait for the user to resume.

steps.title: Transfer anti‑ligand
steps.instruction: Use the p20 multi‑channel pipette to transfer 4 µL of anti‑ligand from the indicated source wells into the appropriate plates.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A1 to slot 1 wells A1‑A24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A1 to slot 1 wells B1‑B24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A2 to slot 2 wells A1‑A24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A2 to slot 2 wells B1‑B24.

steps.title: Pause for user
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and wait for the user to resume.

steps.title: Transfer acceptor
steps.instruction: Use the p20 multi‑channel pipette to transfer 4 µL of acceptor from the indicated source wells into the appropriate plates.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A3 to slot 1 wells A1‑A24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A3 to slot 1 wells B1‑B24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A4 to slot 2 wells A1‑A24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A4 to slot 2 wells B1‑B24.

steps.title: Pause for user
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and wait for the user to resume.

steps.title: Transfer donor
steps.instruction: Use the p20 multi‑channel pipette to transfer 4 µL of donor from the indicated source wells into the appropriate plates.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A5 to slot 1 wells A1‑A24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A5 to slot 1 wells B1‑B24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A6 to slot 2 wells A1‑A24.
Transfer 4 µL from slot 6 well A6 to slot 2 wells B1‑B24.
